description: Decode the input text into ordered [label, integer value] records. Preserve every occurrence.
source:
import csv
from io import StringIO

def solve(x):
    data = StringIO(x)
    reader = csv.DictReader(data)
    pairs = []
    for row in reader:
        label = row['label']
        value = int(row['value'])
        pairs.append([label, value])
    return pairs
